title: customers.consent-withdrawn.v1
description: A customer withdrew consent she had given. Separate from customers.consent-recorded.v1 because this is the one a consumer must act on: data-classification.md section 5.3 says the record exists to honour a withdrawal immediately. There is no status field — the event type is the status.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the withdrawal was recorded, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The customer. Ordering is preserved per aggregate, so this cannot arrive before the grant it revokes.

organisationId.description: The organisation the customer belongs to.

recordId.description: The withdrawal record. Withdrawing appends a row rather than changing the one that granted, so this is the withdrawal, not the grant it revokes.

purposeKey.description: The purpose she is withdrawing from, by its stable key.

wordingVersion.description: The wording version the withdrawal was recorded against.

branchId.description: The branch the withdrawal was taken at, or null where it was taken at none.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
